items.title: 2 reference photos · Street Eye Contact
items.prompt: Ultra photoreal candid moment on a quiet, nearly empty Milan street during the afternoon. The scene is bathed in bright 2 PM natural sunlight. Two people based on the uploaded reference images stand at a short distance looking directly at each other across the cobblestone street. Their eyes are locked in a quiet suspended second of first-sight love, with an intimate, magnetic, and deeply human emotional pull. The environment is serene, featuring only historic Milanese architecture and sunlight. Their faces maintain high identity fidelity to the input images, preserving unique facial features and bone structure. Hair colors, styles, and textures must be preserved exactly as seen in the reference images. One person wears a daily-style white-based cotton button-down shirt paired with classic blue denim jeans. Another wears a casual-fit dark shirt. Expressions show soft emotional pull, warmth, and silent recognition — soft affectionate eyes, relaxed eyelids, and a faint tender smile beginning naturally. No shock, no fear, no surprise. Shot on handheld 50mm f/2 lens, shallow depth of field with imperfect focus falloff. Mid-shot view, clear unobstructed composition with eye-level angle. Real 2 PM natural sun creating realistic low-light texture on skin with natural shine and visible pores (no smoothing). Cinematic but natural color palette with deep blacks, charcoal, and warm amber tones. Perfect human anatomy. No text, no ring, no perfect pose.

items.title: 2 reference photos · Morning Bloom at Home
items.prompt: An ultra photorealistic candid morning scene in a softly lit living room, capturing an intimate unstaged moment between two people. The person in the foreground gently holds a bouquet of fresh flowers with both hands, bringing them close to smell with eyes lightly closed or peacefully gazing downward, expression showing serene contentment and natural tenderness without exaggerated passion. Standing very close behind, the second person leans slightly forward with hands resting naturally on the first person's waist, conveying quiet protective warmth and comfortable closeness. Muted morning color palette of soft cream, warm beige, and natural tones with restrained cinematic grading. No rings, no text, no watermarks, no logos, no posed advertisement aesthetics.
